description: On every D/G Adam call, compute the ordinary Adam direction u_t=(theta_adam-theta)/lr_t; apply theta += lr_t*(2*u_t-u_previous). First call uses ordinary Adam. Previous direction is uncorrected and scaled with the CURRENT group learning rate, preserving original decay. Both players and all original optimizer groups participate, including auxiliary-loss gradients; no target information.
initialization: retained audited CPU fixtures; native CUDA training and random draws

compute.base_updates: one D and one G per host outer step; no added critic steps
compute.comparison: equal outer steps and equal model/gradient evaluations; added tensor arithmetic/memory, wall time measured

checkpoint: memory stored in optimizer state; qualification continuation required after all 22
